cases.title: Validate a Concession SmartPass
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a concession SmartPass validates when valid and is rejected with the correct reason when invalid.

cases.title: Validate a Half-Fare SmartPass
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Half-Fare SmartPass validates when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate a Metro Daylink smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Metro Daylink smartcard validates when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate a Metro Multi-Journey smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Metro Multi-Journey smartcard validates in its zone (deducting a journey) and is rejected out of zone or when invalid.

cases.title: Validate a Metro Travelcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Metro Travelcard validates when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey smartcard validates (deducting a journey) when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate an iLink smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm an iLink smartcard (and Belfast Visitor Pass) validates in its zone and is rejected out of zone or when invalid.

cases.title: Validate an aLink smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm an aLink smartcard validates when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate a yLink or 24+ smartcard
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a valid yLink (or 24+) smartcard presented within its valid time band, and one presented outside its valid time band
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Validate a Translink Employee smartcard
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Translink employee smartcard validates when valid and is rejected when invalid.

cases.title: Validate an EA Smartpass (Pupil and Further Education)
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a valid EA Pupil Smartpass presented on a school-term weekday within its valid time
**AND** you have the same pass to present at a weekend (or during a school holiday, or before start / after expiry / outside the valid time)
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Smartcard — inter-device top-up then validate on PV
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Metro Travelcard has been topped up on a POS (or a legacy device), not on the PV
**AND** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you also have a card that was topped up on its last day of travel and one with no days remaining
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Validation — invalid reasons displayed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a seeded card for each invalid condition (wrong location, wrong time band, expired product, hotlisted, wrong zone, unreadable)
**AND** you can verify denied validations in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Validation — passback
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm passback is applied when a card is re-presented within the passback period, showing the journeys/period remaining.

cases.title: Validation — machine not in service
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV shows Machine Not In Service and does not validate when it is out of service.

cases.title: Validation — offline transaction
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV validates offline when back-office comms are unavailable and uploads the offline transactions once comms return.

cases.title: Rail — NIR transfer validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Rail (NIR) PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a transfer-eligible iLink smartcard that has just made a first NIR journey (inside its transfer window) and a non-eligible smartcard
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Rail — zone validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Rail PV at a station within a defined zone is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a zonal smartcard valid for this station's zone and one whose zone does not cover this station
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Rail — ABT tap success shows the Northern Ireland travel line
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Rail/NIR PV has ABT enabled and is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless payment card accepted for an NIR tap

cases.title: ABT — contactless tap validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV on a Tap-On-Only route has ABT/cEMV enabled and is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless Visa payment card (or Mastercard / mobile wallet)
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: ABT — declined or errored tap
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV has ABT/cEMV enabled and is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a card that is declined, expired or deliberately mis-read
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: ABT — BIN, Deny and Pilot list handling
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV has the BIN, Deny and Pilot lists applied via TMS
**AND** you have a card on the Deny list, a card whose BIN is blocked, and a card governed by the Pilot list
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: cEMV — tap enablement by route, location and fare
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV uses route-attribute, location and fare checks to enable cEMV
**AND** you can place the PV in a context where all three checks pass, and one where a check fails
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: Glider TOO — tap-on-only flat-fare journeys
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV is on a Tap-On-Only flat-fare route (e.g. Glider G1) and is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless card
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: Glider — transfers
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV has ABT enabled and is showing the Present screen
**AND** a contactless card has just tapped a first Glider journey (inside its transfer window)
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: ABT — end-to-end journey to back office
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with ABT enabled and back-office comms available is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless card and can verify the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: ABT — Pilot List management and validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV is configured for the Pilot List via TMS
**AND** you have a pilotlist.zip to apply (including registration mode), an EMV card on the list and one not on the list
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and export via Device Log Manager

cases.title: ABT — Deny and BIN list updates
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV and back-office comms is showing the Present screen
**AND** the back office can publish delta and full Deny/BIN list updates
**AND** you have a card on the Deny/BIN list and can verify the CloudFare activity log
**AND** a full-size Deny list (~200,000 entries) can be staged for download

cases.title: FEIG — reader software management
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with a FEIG reader is connected to CloudFare TMS
**AND** newer Transparent, PCA and FEIG OS versions are staged for deployment

cases.title: FEIG — card reading
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with a FEIG reader is in service
**AND** you have an ITSO smartcard, a valid EMV card and an invalid EMV card
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: cEMV — decline reasons and route-type enablement
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have cards for each decline condition (ODA fail, unsupported scheme e.g. AMEX, expired, invalid BIN, AID fail, card clash, deny/negative list, unreadable)
**AND** a card can be re-presented within the configured ABT Passback window
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: cEMV — JourneyTap audit and alighting-stage derivation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV on a Tap-On-Only route is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless card and can verify the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: cEMV — tap audit content (JourneyTap, stop/stage, direction, payment method)
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV on a Tap On Only route is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a valid contactless card and can inspect the audit record in CloudFare and the transaction in MERIT

cases.title: cEMV — EMV result screens and transaction generation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a Glider PV with cEMV is showing the Present screen
**AND** you have a contactless card that can succeed and one that fails, plus a smartcard
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: FEIG — update without TID/TK fails safely, PV app software still updates
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a FEIG firmware update fails safely (without bricking the reader or corrupting its state) when the device group lacks a TID/TK, while the PV application software update in the same distribution still completes.

cases.title: Barcode — multi-use validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen with its barcode reader armed
**AND** you have a valid multi-use barcode with uses remaining and one presented beyond its allowed uses
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: Barcode — early-morning expiry displays the previous day
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** example media: a valid multiple-use barcode whose encoded expiry time falls between 00:00 and 04:00 (per the CR116 early-expiry rule)
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: PV — barcode/smartcard reader disconnect shows the correct banner and raises an event
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV shows the correct not-accepted banner (matching the approved UI spec) and raises/clears a back-office event when the barcode or smartcard reader disconnects and reconnects.

cases.title: Legacy Smartcard — journey- and time-based cards validate
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a valid legacy journey-based smartcard, a valid legacy time-based smartcard and an invalid legacy smartcard
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Card technology — MIFARE and DESFire
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a MIFARE Classic EV1 card and a DESFire card, both carrying valid products
**AND** you can verify records in the CloudFare activity log, MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.title: Passback — re-presentation within the window is handled per product rules
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm passback is applied when a card is re-presented at the PV within the passback window.

cases.title: Operating Times — validates in-hours, out of service outside them
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV has configured operating times
**AND** you have a valid smartcard to present inside and outside the operating window

cases.title: Technician Menu — login
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV is in service displaying the Technician Menu login screen
**AND** you have a valid technician smartcard with its correct PIN, and an invalid card / wrong PIN

cases.title: Technician Menu — location settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu with back-office comms available
**AND** you can view the current home location and select a new one from the server list

cases.title: Technician Menu — display settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu
**AND** you are on the Brightness page (Mode shows Manual or Ambient)

cases.title: Technician Menu — software and configuration versions
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Technician Menu — force communications
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu
**AND** the PV has pending audit records and pending download files

cases.title: Technician Menu — network settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu
**AND** the PV network interface shows its static IP (192.168.3.10 on the test rig)
**AND** the PV has both an Ethernet and a Cellular interface

cases.title: Technician Menu — operating times
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Technician Menu — backup, layout and audible feedback
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an engineer is signed in to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Technician Menu — sign off
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu with comms available
**AND** you can verify the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Technician Menu — reboot
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu with comms available
**AND** you can verify the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Technician Menu — audio settings
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu on the Audio page

cases.title: Technician Menu — auto sign-off and page timeouts
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed in to the Technician Menu with comms available
**AND** you can verify the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: PV commissioning — uncommissioned until location programmed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an uncommissioned PV with an unprogrammed Plinth-ID
**AND** you have a technician smartcard + PIN and the PV has back-office comms available

cases.title: Single-Use Barcode — rejected as not accepted on this device
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV is in service with its barcode reader armed
**AND** the PV validates multiple-use barcodes only (single-use is validated by POS and TVM, never the PV)
**AND** example media: a Corethree single-use Walk-up (type W) barcode, Scheme ID 5720

cases.title: Multiple-Use Barcode — a valid barcode shows the green success result
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV is in service with its barcode reader armed
**AND** example media: a Corethree mLink multiple-use barcode (format 02, Scheme ID 5720, mode BUS 0001) for a valid in-date product, presented on the signed-on route between its boarding and alighting stops

cases.title: Multiple-Use Barcode — an invalid barcode shows the red failure result
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV is in service with its barcode reader armed
**AND** example media: a Corethree multiple-use barcode (format 02, Scheme ID 5720) whose expiry has passed, so the current time is later than its encoded End time

cases.title: Pilot List — an enrolled FEIG token validates and audits normally
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV deployed with Enable Pilot List = True and a topology that has ABT enabled via the ABT Type route attribute
**AND** example media: a cEMV card whose FEIG token is present in the imported pilotlist.dat
**AND** you can verify the audit record in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

cases.title: Pilot List — a non-enrolled token is rejected with no audit event
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV deployed with Enable Pilot List = True and ABT enabled via the ABT Type route attribute
**AND** example media: a cEMV card whose FEIG token is NOT in the imported pilotlist.dat
**AND** you can confirm the absence of an audit event in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Pilot Registration — the registration file uploads once per day at End-of-Day
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV in registration mode (Enable Registration Mode = True, Enable Pilot List = False)
**AND** example: several cEMV cards tapped during the day, each capturing its FEIG token into the on-device pilot registration file
**AND** you can verify uploads in CloudFare Device Logging

cases.title: NIR Audit — a rail TOTO tap posts a conformant PV audit record
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a NIR PV whose home-location first route carries ABT Type "Tap On Tap Off" and whose boarding location is within the Northern Ireland Zone
**AND** example tap: a cEMV card tapped at Lanyon Place against the configured "ABT Tap Product Name" product (product id 6000)
**AND** you can inspect the audit record in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Legacy Transfer — decided by the product Transfer Time, not a route property
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV validating a legacy rail smartcard whose product Transfer Time is 90 minutes
**AND** example card: an iLink Zone 4 smartcard first validated at Botanic, then re-presented at Lanyon Place 20 minutes later, inside the LastValidated + Transfer Time window
**AND** you can inspect the audited transaction in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Legacy Transfer — re-validation outside the product Transfer Time counts as a journey
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV validating a legacy rail smartcard whose product Transfer Time is 90 minutes
**AND** example card: an iLink Zone 4 smartcard first validated at Botanic, then re-presented at Lanyon Place 100 minutes later, outside the LastValidated + Transfer Time window
**AND** you can inspect the audited transaction in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Power — recovers to service with transactions intact
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the PV is in service with recorded (not-yet-uploaded) transactions on-device

cases.title: PV to BOS — software and FEIG update via CloudFare TMS
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV software or FEIG firmware update is available from CloudFare TMS
**AND** you can verify the reported version in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: PV to BOS — Deny and BIN list download
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the back office has updated Deny and BIN lists
**AND** the PV has cEMV and back-office comms
**AND** you can verify the download in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: PV to BOS — transaction upload
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV has recorded validation and tap transactions on-device
**AND** you can verify the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Clock — GMT/BST change carries into time-based validation
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the PV clock is approaching a daylight saving transition (GMT-to-BST or BST-to-GMT)
**AND** you have a time-limited product to validate after the change

cases.title: PV to BOS — MERIT heartbeat
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV sends a MERIT heartbeat transaction periodically and whenever it enters an in-service state.

cases.title: PV — scheduled reboot
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV has a scheduled reboot time configured
**AND** you can verify the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: PV to BOS — configuration and topology distribution
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the back office has configuration and topology updates for the PV
**AND** you have an immediate update, a future-dated update and a deliberately corrupt configuration file

cases.title: PV — scheduled maintenance
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV performs scheduled maintenance from idle and resumes when coming out of the suspended state.

cases.title: PV — validation and barcode performance timings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV in service showing the Present SmartCard or Barcode screen
**AND** you have a smartcard and a batch of barcodes with a stopwatch / captured timings

cases.title: PV — stability and recovery
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV in service connected to CloudFare TMS
**AND** you can force a failed boot and a white-startup-screen or black-screen freeze, and run the PV over an extended period

cases.title: PV — asset and version reporting
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a PV connected to the back office
**AND** you can view the software version page and inspect CloudFare Asset Manager

cases.title: PV to BOS — Device Log Manager retrieves device logs on request
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a PV connected to the back office
**AND** you have access to Device Log Manager

cases.title: Comms Lock — a sustained loss of both Ethernet and cellular drives the PV out of service
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a PV enters a communication-locked, out-of-service state only when BOTH its Ethernet (primary) and cellular (secondary/backup) comms channels are lost for a sustained period — a single-channel Ethernet failure alone fails over to cellular and does not trigger this state (see 'Comms Failover').

cases.title: Comms Recovery — transactions queued during an outage are delivered on restore
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an Ethernet PV that took taps while the Translink-network connection was down
**AND** the taps were queued on-device with no data loss

cases.title: Comms Failover — Ethernet loss fails the PV over to cellular
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the PV fails over from its Ethernet (primary) to cellular (secondary/backup) communication channel when Ethernet fails, continues validating normally on cellular, and fails back to Ethernet once Ethernet is restored.
